answer.evidence: TX normal 0.46dBm in spec with stable bias/temp, B-ODF and B-RX no light (<-50dBm), PM sudden RX_LOS 2026-10-17 22:00 from -11.8 to -40dBm. OTDR 1550+1310 from A shows end at 18.20/18.19km fibre, from B shows end at 13.16km fibre (sum 31.36km = total fibre), trace shows abrupt drop to noise with no continuation, same physical point. Anchored between SC-03 (13.668 route /14.057 fibre) and SC-04 (19.484 route /20.031 fibre) => route ~17.7km. Connectors clean, SC-02 0.97dB is G.652/G.655 backscatter mismatch not cause. Correlates with road works/flooding km18-20.

transcript.content: Service ticket opened — pulling link records and alarms to pinpoint the failure.
